text: Callaway Golf is a brand of Callaway Golf Company, a Delaware corporation listed on the New York Stock Exchange (ticker CALY; until 2026 Topgolf Callaway Brands Corp.). Its 2026 proxy statement lists BlackRock (11.14%), Thomas G. Dundon (10.25%), PEP TG Investments LP (6.21%) and Dimensional Fund Advisors (5.06%) as its 5%+ holders; no state or state fund is among them.
short: Callaway is a brand of NYSE-listed Callaway Golf Company (CALY); 5%+ holders are BlackRock, Thomas Dundon, PEP TG Investments and Dimensional.
